text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel won the Satsuki Sho. The joy 
of standing atop the Classic stage hit 
differently, and she found herself 
greedily yearning for the Japanese Derby 
too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, accompanied by her 
Trainer, Sakura Laurel goes for an 
examination on her legs. The test results 
show no abnormalities.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the doctor warns her that she was 
on the verge of breakdown. If she runs 
beyond her limits, she might never be able 
to run again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel was unable to break that 
truth to her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby—her intense passion for 
this once-in-a-lifetime stage stifled her 
words...
